long_biography.plain_text:
After studying history at Tufts University, Anastassis George David began inside the Coca-Cola bottling system, working in sales and marketing before a period in accounting and business finance. He then became an adviser to Kar-Tess, the family holding vehicle whose beverage interests had shaped his father's career.

David moved from family investment work into long-term corporate governance. He joined Coca-Cola HBC's board, became vice-chair and ultimately succeeded his father as non-executive chair. His wider appointments span Aegean Airlines and dry-cargo shipping companies, but the family's indirect interest in Coca-Cola HBC remains the clearest basis of his wealth and public business identity.
